basics.name: Brandon Duy Nguyen
basics.label: Computer Science Student & Software Developer Intern
basics.summary: I am a Computer Science student at the University of Hawaiʻi at Mānoa (B.S., expected December 2026) who builds and runs real web applications. My main project is a full-stack Brown Dust 2 companion site built on Cloudflare Workers and D1 that serves a live player community. I also work as an IT Consultant at UH Mānoa's Information Technology Center, where I troubleshoot hardware, software, and network issues for students and faculty. I work with JavaScript, TypeScript, Python, Java, and SQL, along with React, Next.js, Node.js, PostgreSQL, and SQLite. I am looking for full-time software engineering roles starting after graduation.
